1.mascotDialogue: Collision here no be error, my pikin — na outcome wey the whole design dey plan for! Each bucket just dey become small linked list instead of one slot.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 13, na the whole strategy — instead of overwriting whoever already dey inside the bucket, the new node just point at her and become the new head! Nothing ever lost to collision.

3.mascotDialogue: Bucket 3 now dey carry two-node chain — 17, inserted after 10, land for the head, exactly as insert-at-head predict!

4.mascotDialogue: The chain dey look perfectly fine — one node, no dangling pointer for sight. Na the trap be that! The bug no be broken pointer, na silently vanished one — and this app dey show 'lost node' plainly, so she never invisible.
